horner_nat.note: Horner evaluation of a natural coefficient list (lowest degree first) at a natural point: upstream horner_rec at nat; the empty list is 0 at every point, x = 0 gives the head coefficient, no guard; the domination bound needs 1 <= t (counterexample [:: 1; 1] at 0 in the public client); coefficient order matters ([1;2;3]@10 = 321, reversed 123).
